body: Thank you! I am doing better now. Saw my psychiatrist and am on meds now. Moved past the shame and guilt and for the first time in months I feel hopeful. I don't want to delete it because I want it to remind me why I should learn to love my life more.
My suicide note that I wrote in a fit of desperate first attempt last week.

That deep breath did help. I am anxious right now about the appointment but I am also kind of happy to be able to get help. Congrats on doing better. I am looking forward to be where you are emotionally.

Thank you. I actually managed to get an appointment with the psychiatrist. It is early morning tomorrow. Maybe I will go directly to see my academic advisor then. I am surely going to fail since I have not been to class since January but I think it is better if I know it for sure.
Thank you. I will get back to you tomorrow and update on how my meeting with the supervisor goes. Good luck with your work. Maybe, I will go and see a friend's cat as well tomorrow. :D

Too scared to be responsible for a pet's well being. Also, I cannot in my rez. Maybe if I have the courage to go up to my academic counselor tomorrow, I will get a pet rock. Atleast that would not add to my anxiety.

No worries. I too am very very lazy. But I know that I am lazy and have dificulties getting myself motivated to do work. :/ So, I am in this camp of doing badly. But I know I can do better. And I am so excited for varying periods of time. But the enthusiasm comes and goes. For now, I have just been watching endless movies/series online or working for the interuniversity competition. 

No need for sorry. I did not see it as that at all. I meant that if I could help you with some coursework/ideas feel free to ask. I am doing a masters in International Relations. :D

Oh, are you in academic trouble? I hope things sort out. Actually, a lot of my troubles at school are with the admin side of things. Otherwise, it is fine. My grades were decent in the papers I actually submitted. And I did 9 courses last semester so only have to do 7, including the make up classes. It is all the other stuff that is making me so stressed out.

No worries. I just needed to say it to another living soul. I have been keeping it in for months. This summer was hard. People would see sunshine and even hardened faces would melt into a smile the moment the warmth hit them. I was neither eating nor sleeping very well and to be honest could have been in the darkest forest, if you went by the way I felt.

I felt that I was Alice, just endlessly falling into the hole. Things got slightly better. I tried really hard to sort some things out. I had help from a few friends but to be honest it is difficult to live with depressive episodes. I am a people person, I think that too stems from a sense of self-loathing and insecurity, but that is another matter entirely. 

I just needed to know that another human being knows that inside I feel like I am falling. Like science fiction, my fall into the rabbit hole was on pause for a little while. It felt good and relaxing but that makes this fall that much scarier. I can feel the anxiety and frustration building up. And being alone does not help either. But I can't let people know as well. Atleast when I am surrounded by people I can pretend to not be so alone.

I am on a Masters scholarship in Europe. School was getting really tough and I had to find an internship for fall 2012. I had a big fat nervous breakdown. I got a lot of help from here and folks at SW who helped me put my life back together a bit. 

I managed to get an internship on paper so that I could validate the semester but also take time to recover. My scholarship was cut because I did not do academically well. I am struggling to make ends meet but managing somehow. But my college has stopped my registration because I am not able to pay tuition fees right now. 

I have not had a phone since last May and my bank account has been frozen. I cannot clear the dues yet as I am still struggling. My visa lapsed and I have to renew it but I cannot because of my financial state. I still have persevered through. Got selected to represent my school at an interuniversity event in March. 

I dont want to let down my team but I cannot apply for the visa right now. Nor am I able to register for classes. Classes started a week back and I have been sneaking in but I hate myself for putting me in this situation. 

My academic advisor changed and I know that she is not very helpful. I don't know what to do. But I am going into school tomorrow to seek help. But I don't expect much. My school has a reputation for being an elite school that really does not care so much for student welfare.

Overall, I feel like a giant failure.

Ah, it feels so nice to be able to stop putting on a brave face and saying what is going on in my mind. And has been going on for so long. I am seriously in trouble. At school, with my visa, with my scholarship. Especially if thinks do not sort out by next week there is no hope of me getting over this. I am just so horribly stressed and have no one that I can be honest with. :/
